manual_dieback_note: A subagent viewed all 362 UK Sep-Nov iNaturalist photos of mint, lemon balm, chives, garlic chives and oregano (no annotation): 14 dieback, 193 green, 24 problem, 131 unusable. The 14 dieback picks were re-viewed here; 12 kept. A second subagent viewed all 258 UK Sep-Nov photos of Japanese maple, male fern and roses: 62 autumn (32 of them uniformly red maples, left out as possible red-leaved cultivars), 137 green, 1 problem, 58 unusable (incl. 11 sweetgums filed as maple); its 30 other autumn picks were re-viewed here, 26 kept. The first subagent's 24 'problem' picks (mostly pale stippling on lemon balm, likely leafhopper) were not used: the cause is a reading of the photo, and leafhopper damage is often tolerated rather than treated.
